secoes.corpo:
We were founded out of the need to provide nursing professionals with a reliable, fast, and easily accessible technological platform. Our portal centralizes scales, assessment scores, drip rate calculations, and dosing, reducing administrative time and the risk of errors in clinical care.

Today, we are a constantly evolving platform, translated into multiple languages and used in emergency departments, ICUs, and universities, strengthening evidence-based practice.

Growing user base and validated tools.

textoCompleto:
Mission, Vision, and Values

About Us

Supporting clinical practice, education, and safety in clinical decision-making with high-precision tools available worldwide.

Who We Are
We were founded out of the need to provide nursing professionals with a reliable, fast, and easily accessible technological platform. Our portal centralizes scales, assessment scores, drip rate calculations, and dosing, reducing administrative time and the risk of errors in clinical care.

Today, we are a constantly evolving platform, translated into multiple languages and used in emergency departments, ICUs, and universities, strengthening evidence-based practice.

Growing user base and validated tools.

Mission
To provide highly accurate clinical support tools and calculators, accessible globally, to optimize time and promote safety in nursing decision-making and practice.

Vision
To be the leading national and international digital platform supporting evidence-based practice, continuously innovating in the development of educational technologies for healthcare professionals.

Values
Safety: An
absolute focus on the patient.

Education:
Ongoing support for teaching.

Responsibility:
Evidence-based clinical decisions.

Ethics:
Transparency and professional standards.

Community
Join our community. Stay informed, share experiences, and discuss clinical cases on our official forum.
